sh.search.label: Search skills
sh.c1.title: Fourier Series Waveform Synthesizer
sh.c1.desc: Fast Leafer.js rendering. Rotating circles add sine harmonics into any waveform; drag the mouse to change the harmonic count and frequency.
sh.c2.title: Trigonometric Projection Animator
sh.c2.desc: A drag-and-link model on Leafer.js. Drag the point on the unit circle and the sine, cosine and tangent curves are drawn in real time.
sh.c3.title: Monte Carlo π Simulator
sh.c3.desc: Throw points into a square at high frequency and count the ones inside the circle — a live, visual estimate of pi.
sh.c4.title: GeoGebra to LeaferJS Converter
sh.c4.desc: Give it GeoGebra logic and it rebuilds the interaction as lightweight, native Leafer.js Canvas code you can embed in any teaching site.
sh.c5.title: Conic Sections Explorer
sh.c5.desc: Drag the focus or directrix of an ellipse, hyperbola or parabola; the curve redraws instantly and eccentricity updates as it changes.
sh.c6.title: Calculus Visualization Guide
sh.c6.desc: Turns limits, derivatives and triple integrals into interactive 3D geometry so students can see the theorems instead of memorising them.
sh.c7.title: Geometry Model Reasoning Assistant
sh.c7.desc: Recognises classic construction models — half-angle, hand-in-hand, three equal angles on a line — and lays out several solution paths.
sh.c8.title: Primary Word-Problem Story Builder
sh.c8.desc: Rewrites classic word problems as vivid stories, with courseware that teaches both line diagrams and setting up unknowns.
sh.c9.title: Tiered Homework & Exam Generator
sh.c9.desc: Set the knowledge points and difficulty mix, and it assembles a personalised paper with A/B/C difficulty tiers.
sh.c10.title: Math History & Anecdote Master
sh.c10.desc: Classroom openers drawn from mathematicians' lives and famous paradoxes — ideal for warming up a lesson or writing an introduction.
sh.c11.title: GeoGebra Script Generator
sh.c11.desc: Describe the dynamic maths effect you want in plain language and get the GeoGebra script or commands straight away.
sh.c12.title: LaTeX Formula Typesetting
sh.c12.desc: Turn handwritten or screenshot formulas into clean standard LaTeX in one click, exportable to Word and Markdown.
sh.c13.title: Everyday Math Modeling for Kids
sh.c13.desc: Starts from cases students already know — traffic-light timing, delivery routes — and builds cross-subject PBL projects.
